sourceTitle: GENKI I: An Integrated Course in Elementary Japanese (3rd edition)

rowSemantics: One row per printed vocabulary entry. Variant readings or distinct senses have multiple catalog targets. Parenthetical particles and optional phrase text are usage annotations, not extra rows.
